name: The Summit Library
source:
Your trade as a Keeper is suffering under the rule of the current Emperor, but you've just gotten lucky – the Summit Library, the largest and most important Library in the Eawin Empire, has requested your services. 

But when you arrive you suddenly find yourself in a dangerous magical mystery -- something's wrong with the books, and the Library is falling apart at the seams.  

Also, there might be a war? But the Summit Library is situated on neutral territory, so that doesn't affect you.  

...Right? 


As you set out the uncover the Library's secrets, you get drawn into the complexities of the Empire's politics; rebellion, betrayal, underground organisations, and more. Meet the various people residing at the Summit Library; make alliances and enemies; fall in love and get your heart broken. 

May you live to see the end of this tale written.

[from [url=https://qkayoo.itch.io/the-summit-library]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你作为守护者的职业在现任皇帝的统治下受到了影响，但你很幸运——顶峰图书馆，伊文帝国最大、最重要的图书馆，已经请求你的服务。

但当你到达时，你突然发现自己陷入了一个危险的魔法谜团中——书籍出了问题，图书馆正在分崩离析。

还有，可能会发生战争？但峰会图书馆位于中立地区，所以这不会影响你。

…正确的？


当你开始揭开图书馆的秘密时，你会被卷入帝国政治的复杂性之中；叛乱、背叛、地下组织等等。与居住在峰会图书馆的各色人等见面；结盟或树敌；坠入爱河并让你心碎。

愿你能活着看到这个故事的结局。

[来自[url=https://qkayoo.itch.io/the-summit-library]itch.io[/url]]
